name: The Night Agent
description: Brought together by a midnight phone call, an FBI agent and a cybersecurity expert must unravel an ever-growing web of political conspiracies.

videos.title: The Call
videos.overview: While working the night action desk, FBI agent Peter receives a distress call and is soon put in charge of protecting cybersecurity expert Rose.

videos.title: Redial
videos.overview: After looking for a link between the Campbells and the FBI, Peter is forced to go on the run with Rose in search of a hard drive — and more answers.

videos.title: The Zookeeper
videos.overview: Peter teams up with Rose for a risky mission at the White House. Elsewhere, a notable agent joins the security detail for the vice president's daughter.

videos.title: Eyes Only
videos.overview: Rose and Peter seek out one of the Campbells' recent contacts and uncover new intel. Monks opens up to Chelsea. Paulo makes a move on Maddie.

videos.title: The Marionette
videos.overview: Peter visits someone close to Hawkins. Rose makes a key connection. Maddie’s night out takes a dangerous turn, spurring the Secret Service into action.

videos.title: Fathoms
videos.overview: With assassins hot on their trail, Peter and Rose split up en route to the White House. A shocking discovery quickly puts their lives in jeopardy.

videos.title: Best Served Cold
videos.overview: Now in hiding, Peter and Rose grow closer and investigate a potential bombing suspect. At the White House, the conspirators obtain a disturbing tape.

videos.title: Redux
videos.overview: More truths emerge about the bombing suspect's identity. Chelsea and Peter race to find Maddie after she sends a video with a coded message.

videos.title: The Devil We Know
videos.overview: After new revelations surface, Peter and Rose scramble to find more evidence with help from Chelsea and Maddie. A bigger threat looms at Camp David.

videos.title: Fathers
videos.overview: With lives at stake, the group tries to stop a nefarious plot before it's too late. In the aftermath, Peter confronts the past and begins a new chapter.

videos.title: Call Tracking
videos.overview: After a disastrous mission in Bangkok, Peter goes AWOL to track an American agent accused of leaking secrets. Meanwhile, Rose receives a disturbing call.

videos.title: Disconnected
videos.overview: Reunited at last, Peter and Rose race to intercept Warren. Noor weighs using her access to classified Iranian intelligence for her own gain.

videos.title: Government Property
videos.overview: Catherine aids Peter's off-the-books investigation into Foxglove while Noor stumbles upon an unexpected encounter. A hijacking spirals out of control.

videos.title: Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Peter and Rose infiltrate a party at the Iranian ambassador's home, arousing Javad's suspicion. Tomás and Markus lock horns over the Foxglove plan.

videos.title: A Family Matter
videos.overview: Eager for intel about Night Action, Jacob makes Solomon a lucrative offer. Javad senses a traitor in his midst. Sami undertakes a covert mission in Iran.

videos.title: A Good Agent
videos.overview: Rose grapples with a crisis of conscience. Viktor reveals his true goal to Tomás, and the hunter becomes the hunted when Solomon's team stalks Peter.

videos.title: Tilt
videos.overview: Peter plays hardball to force Solomon to talk. Following a lead, Rose seeks answers from a Foxglove scientist — but finds herself in a lethal situation.

videos.title: Divergence
videos.overview: Desperate to locate Rose, Peter makes a game-changing deal with Jacob. Tomás discovers just how far Markus is willing to go in service to his father.

videos.title: Cultural Exchange
videos.overview: Breaching one of the most high-security locations in New York puts Peter's skills to the test. Rose and Dr. Cole enact a daring plan to stop Markus.

videos.title: Buyer's Remorse
videos.overview: With time running out, Peter and Rose scramble to prevent a mass casualty event. Catherine floats an intriguing proposal.

videos.title: Call Waiting
videos.overview: A deadly attack ignites a crisis within the White House. In Istanbul, Peter pursues a fugitive who's stolen classified files.

videos.title: Package Deal
videos.overview: Peter considers a deal with the devil. Isabel follows a suspicious document trail down the rabbit hole. Night Action gets a harsh lesson in compliance.

videos.title: Dark Matters
videos.overview: Peter brings POTUS up to speed after a sting operation. A lethal cat-and-mouse game unfolds at the home of a reluctant source.

videos.title: Orion
videos.overview: Peter's visit to an exclusive hunting lodge turns into a fight for survival. Chelsea's concerns grow when a White House statement doesn't add up.

videos.title: The Isolation Play
videos.overview: Every second counts as Peter and Adam infiltrate a casino on a high-stakes mission. Jay finds clues to the next strike hidden in a crypto wallet.

videos.title: Murky Waters
videos.overview: Chelsea's off-the-books probe worries her closest ally. Peter and Isabel's rescue plan spirals out of control when the Father joins the fray.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time...
videos.overview: An American legal consultant in Mexico finds himself caught in an impossible bind. Years later, he's trapped once again — and Peter is his only hope.

videos.title: Truth Be Told
videos.overview: An enigmatic opponent pushes Peter to his limits in a ruthless mind game. Jacob uses his vast database of secrets as a bargaining chip.

videos.title: Lockstep
videos.overview: With his Cabinet urging swift retaliation, POTUS weighs his options. Isabel and Jay scramble to crack Jacob's code. Peter's day takes an explosive turn.

videos.title: Razzmatazz
videos.overview: On their own, on the run and out of time, Peter and Isabel put their lives on the line to expose the conspiracy — before it silences them for good.
